ValidationRule.description: Prevent User from updating Written response to be sent by Post once it is checked
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint'), IDR_Written_Response_to_be_sent_by_Post__c =false, NOT( ISNEW() ), ISCHANGED(IDR_Written_Response_to_be_sent_by_Post__c), PRIORVALUE(IDR_Written_Response_to_be_sent_by_Post__c) = true )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Written response to be sent by Post cannot be unchecked once selected
